name: P-Gyroid-D Associate Family

definition.domain: plane with branch points at z = 0, +-1, +-3 and infinity (the genus-3 hyperelliptic cover)
definition.note: Extracted from the shipped row's source by AST (complete multi-line lambdas, the shipped rPD coordinate 1-forms (_pgd_om in math_art/minsurf/weierstrass.py): dh = phi3, g = phi3/(phi1 - i*phi2)) and reproduced numerically against the shipped callables over the complex plane, exactly -- no scalar slack. theta = 0 is Schwarz P; the Bonnet angle e^{i theta} sweeps the associate family through the gyroid (38.0148 deg) to Schwarz D (90 deg). Square roots are per-factor principal branches, the shipped code's own convention on its fundamental domain.

provenance.definition: Weierstrass data reproduced numerically against the shipped implementation (math_art/minsurf/zoo.py, row PGD) by sampling g and dh over rings in the complex plane at the row's default parameters: g: matches over 144 complex samples (worst 8.52e-14); dh: matches over 144 complex samples (worst 1.11e-16).
sources: A. H. Schoen, NASA TN D-5541 (1970).
O. Bonnet (1853) for the associate family in general.

discovered_by: Hermann Amandus Schwarz (P, D); Alan H. Schoen (the gyroid member)

caveats: The three named members are the only EMBEDDED ones; a generic associate angle self-intersects, which is why only three of a continuous family have names.
